name: Fractera Data
summary: The single door to stored data: tables, media, vectors, and a pass-through route to the node's other services.

auth.note: Every door but /health requires it. The key is generated by the installer and written to both ends; this service never invents one.

port.note: A wish, not a decision. The node assigns the actual port from the block 24680-24699 and writes it into MICROSERVICES.json. Ask the node, never remember.

env.note: MEASURED, not assumed: server.js calls dotenv with resolve(__dirname, '.env'), and auth-bypass.js reads the same file for FRACTERA_IP_NODOMAIN_MODE. The installer writes THIS name. A service that is asked which file it reads cannot be guessed wrong.

runtime.note: No build step: server.js is both source and production. It is in git, there is no obfuscation.

doors.gives: liveness — the only door that needs no key
what this installation can actually do right now
rows of a table, and row creation
the column ladder: adds what a schema gained
a full icon set from one image
stores a vector next to a row
presence and setting of the embeddings key
the one-door route to another service of this node, by name

languages.note: A machine service: it answers programs, not people, and carries no user-facing words.

pages.note: Empty on purpose. The architect's build pages for this service are a separate step; the folder exists so the repository is not reopened later to change its shape.
